items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: he mentioned that you had done another record with four drummers for Choral with Bobby Rosengarden, Specs Powell and Jimmy Crawford.

ctx.x: It must have been great on the brass players' chops.

Oh yeah. See, so one of them Broadway shows wasn't anything when you rehearse three weeks to do a show. Like Jimmy Crawford say, 'Cozy, just the same as throwing me in the briar patch, rabbit in the briar patch. And I can play this show backwards.' Tell me about the Ethel Merman show he did. He said I know it backwards by now in three weeks because with Jimmy Lunceford you had to know a show in a hour, and have it memorized in your head. Now of course the first show would be a regular dress rehearsal, but the…
I want to get back a step to when you were hired on CBS. Were Emmett Barry and Billy Taylor and George Johnson hired the same time you were?
